# CyberDefenders

> CyberDefenders is a comprehensive blue team training platform offering hands-on labs, certifications, and cyber range investigations for SOC analysts and DFIR professionals.

CyberDefenders provides structured cybersecurity training through interactive labs, CTF challenges, and industry-recognized certifications (CCDL1 and CCDL2). The platform serves individual analysts and enterprise organizations seeking to develop detection, investigation, and incident response capabilities.

## Key Topics

- SOC Analyst Training
- DFIR Certification
- Threat Hunting
- Incident Response
- Blue Team
- Cyber Range
- Hands-on Labs
- Endpoint Forensics
- Cloud Forensics
- Detection Engineering
- Cybersecurity Certification
- CTF Challenges
- Enterprise Security
- KQL
- AWS CloudTrail

## Core Training & Certifications

- [Blue Team Labs & Training](https://cyberdefenders.org/blue-team-labs): Main blue team labs platform with hands-on training covering threat hunting, forensics, and malware analysis.
- [SOC Analyst Training & Certification - CCDL1](https://cyberdefenders.org/certifications/certified-cyberdefender-level1): CCDL1 entry-level SOC analyst certification covering detection, investigation, and incident response.
- [Threat Hunting & DFIR Certification - CCDL2](https://cyberdefenders.org/certifications/certified-cyberdefender-level2): CCDL2 intermediate certification for threat hunting, disk/memory forensics, and incident response skills.
- [Blue Team CTF Challenges](https://cyberdefenders.org/blueteam-ctf-challenges): Hands-on blue team CTF challenges for forensics, threat hunting, and detection engineering practice.

## Enterprise & Solutions

- [Enterprise Security Training](https://cyberdefenders.org/enterprise-security-training): Enterprise security training solution with team dashboards and corporate licensing for organizations.
- [Partnership Opportunities](https://cyberdefenders.org/partner-with-us): Business partnership and reseller opportunities for CyberDefenders training solutions.
- [Affiliate Program](https://cyberdefenders.org/affiliates): Affiliate program offering commissions for referring CyberDefenders training and certifications.

## Learning Resources & Reference

- [CyberDefenders Blog](https://cyberdefenders.org/blog): Blog featuring cybersecurity insights, tutorials, and threat analysis for blue team professionals.
- [Cybersecurity Glossary](https://cyberdefenders.org/cybersecurity-glossary): Comprehensive cybersecurity glossary with definitions, examples, and educational resources.
- [Cybersecurity Certification Roadmap](https://cyberdefenders.org/community/cybersecurity-roadmap): Community-driven cybersecurity certification roadmap comparing blue/red team and infosec certifications.
